name: cmux.terminal.connector/1
docs: Host mode (ghostty-next-switch.md, cloud-app.md): the far end runs its own session host; the local host relays the viewer protocol (GHOSTSNP snapshot plus bytes, size state, input, presence) and does not parse. An app connector runs as the app's server (implements with server: true) and needs the restricted scope terminal:backend. Rust trait TerminalConnector.

methods.connect: ({kind, target}) -> {channel} (a viewer-protocol byte stream the local host relays)

kinds.description: Target kinds this implementation serves; the registry ids are app:<app>/<kind>. Default deny: a kind not listed is never routed here.

status: draft: shapes chosen by the ghostty-next lead (2026-10-04); refined with the first connector before the interface is public
